errors.text_span: in alphabetischer Reihenfolge von Japan bis Frankreich angeordnet sind
errors.evidence: The bars are not arranged in alphabetical order. They are sorted in descending order based on their value (percentage).

errors.text_span: Alle Balken haben eine blaue Farbe, mit Ausnahme des Polen-Balkens, der eine purpurne Farbe hat.
errors.evidence: The bars for 'OECD' and 'EU27' are purple, not the bar for 'Polen' (Poland), which is blue.
The bar for Japan reaches approximately 88%, not 92%.
The bar for France is at 60%, not 69%.
The bars for Sweden, South Korea, and Denmark are all around 80% (approx. 81%, 80%, 79% respectively), not 85%.
The bar for EU27 is at 70%, not 76%.
The bar for the USA is at 70%, not 82%.
The bar for Italy is below 70%, at approximately 67-68%, not 72%.
The bar for Spain is below 70%, at approximately 66%, not 74%.

errors.text_span: auf der Höhe des Balkens für die Vereinigten Königreich
errors.evidence: The blue dot is not at the height of the UK bar (approx. 69%). It is located at a much lower y-value, just below the 60% line.
